test_title: PYST 5: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 02 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

One can never imagine / how hot it gets in Delhi / unless one doesn’t go / there in person.

options.text: how hot it gets in Delhi

solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **unless one doesn’t go**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error here lies in the **third part **of the sentence.
 
• Replace "**doesn't go**" with "**goes**" to correct the sentence.
 
• The conjunction '**Unless**' means** ****except on the condition that or under any other circumstance than.**
 
• So, we cannot use a negative word after '**unless**' as it conveys a negative meaning itself.
 
• Also, **'goes' **will be used as the subject is singular.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2** which contains an error in it.

 

**Corrected sentence**: *One can never imagine how hot it gets in Delhi unless one goes there in person.*
